findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess with shell=True
 * @description Detects subprocess calls with shell=True which can be dangerous.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-true
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::ArgumentNode shellArg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen", "run"]).getACall() and
  shellArg = call.getArgByName("shell") and
  shellArg.asExpr().(ImmutableLiteral).booleanValue() = true
select call, "subprocess call with shell=True detected."
findings.hypothesis: Subprocess calls with shell=True are potential command injection vectors.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe YAML Deserialization
 * @description Detects unsafe YAML deserialization using yaml.load without a SafeLoader.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-yaml-load
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "load_all"]).getACall() and
  not exists(DataFlow::ArgumentNode arg |
    arg = call.getArg(_) and
    (
        arg.asExpr().(Name).getId() = "SafeLoader" or
        arg.asExpr().(Attribute).getAttr() = "SafeLoader" or
        arg.asExpr().(Name).getId() = "CSafeLoader" or
        arg.asExpr().(Attribute).getAttr() = "CSafeLoader"
    )
  )
select call, "Unsafe yaml.load() detected. Use yaml.safe_load() instead."
